description: Glyph names that should be skipped during CMAP and ToUnicode entry creation. A glyph in this set gets no CMap entry, so it stays unmappable from text content while remaining usable via its glyph name, and text extraction surfaces it as GLYPH_UNMAPPED instead. Loaded by crates/pdftract-core/build.rs at compile time; when this file is absent build.rs falls back to a .notdef-only set.
